fullContentHtml:
UPSC CAPF AC Physical Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the Physical Admit Card for the Combined Central Armed Police Force CAPF Examination 2026. This recruitment was released for 349 posts. Applications for the UPSC CAPF AC Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 20 February 2026, to 12 March 2026. The written examination was conducted on 19 July 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this Examination can download their UPSC CAPF AC Physical Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 20 February 2026
  • Last Date : 12 March 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 12 March 2026
  • Exam Date : 19 July 2026
  • Admit Card : 10 July 2026
  • Answer Key : 22 July 2026
  • Result : 25 August 2026
  • Name Wise Result : 08 September 2026
  • PET/ PST Date : 13 to 16 October 2026
  • PET/ PST Admit Card : 30 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPSC CAPF AC Physical Admit Card 2026?

UPSC CAPF AC Physical Admit Card 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
